craft_notes: Sthāyin: roomless words (talk finds no place). Rows: row 1 (unending→no-place). Close: world? (jagat as landing: whence the WORLD). Rejected: 'inexpressible' — kept no-place-found (avakāśa as room, spatial); 'maya' gloss — kept rest (ādi as and-the-rest, unexpanded).

lines: You-and-I and the rest — so unending, always in you, they get no place.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tvamahaṃ so'yamityādi so'nantāni sadā tvayi | na labhante cāvakāśaṃ vacanāni kuto jagat

reads_against.argmap: Where do words go? → Speech finds no room in you: if even I-and-you-talk cannot stay, whence a world of words.
c1_essence: Speech finds no room: if even I-and-you-talk cannot stay, whence a world of words.
